metadata.scope: Huawei-associated English iFixit product categories across all years, teardown/disassembly guides and Chip ID guides. Includes historical Honor devices nested in Huawei categories; the independent Honor Phone category is excluded.
metadata.completeness: Best-effort inventory of written identifications in the reviewed guides, plus specifically documented image-annotation transcriptions; not a certified exhaustive inventory of every chip or product.
method: Enumerated brand-associated product branches in iFixit English category hierarchy.
Fetched category pages and selected teardown, disassembly and Chip ID guides.
Cross-checked all 2,114 entries from the global public teardown index.
Manually reviewed every extracted identification and candidate line for relevance.
Grouped by source guide category; deduplicated identical identification strings within a category, preserving sources.

interpretation.chips: Textual identification entries, not unique physical chip counts. Includes stacked packages, RF modules, sensors, discrete semiconductors and source-listed clock components. Multiple components may share one entry.
interpretation.manufacturers_mentioned: Names mentioned in the identification, not a verified manufacturer or foundry attribution.
interpretation.tentative: True when tentative wording appears in the extracted identification. False does not mean independently verified.
interpretation.empty_chips: No identification extracted in this scan; does not imply the device contains no chips or iFixit never identified them.
interpretation.category_has_children: True means iFixit lists descendant categories; it does not necessarily mean the record is only a product family.
interpretation.variants: Specifications and identifiers refer to the source units. Do not assume all storage sizes, regional models or revisions use the same chips. Combined-device teardown titles remain assigned to their source category.
interpretation.coverage_status: The text_chip_identifications_found value is retained for schema compatibility; consult sources[].extraction_method for documented image-annotation transcriptions.
interpretation.brand_attribution: Brand association follows iFixit category labels, not independent verification of corporate ownership or physical manufacture.

excluded_material: Unlabeled image-only chips (no identity inferred from bare markings)
Comprehensive news-archive, replacement-guide and category-specification extraction

attribution.license: CC BY-NC-SA 3.0, subject to source-specific notices
attribution.changes: Factual extraction, grouping, deduplication and selected condensation of chip descriptions. Original narrative and images are not reproduced.

metadata.image_review_note: No systematic OCR of board photos. Only written guide identifications are included unless a source explicitly records another extraction method.
